title: The Easy Way to Find New Donors While Fundraising Online
actionable_recommendations: Define your ideal new donor to tailor your messaging effectively.
Create a donor magnet, such as a checklist or guide, to offer value before asking for donations.
Set up a visible area on your website for the donor magnet and ensure it's easily accessible.
Use an email sign-up form to capture potential donors' information when they access the donor magnet.
Develop a five-part email welcome series to nurture new leads and build engagement.
claims_requiring_current_verification: The effectiveness of specific growth strategies for small nonprofits is not guaranteed; outcomes depend on various factors.
Email platforms like Mailchimp and Constant Contact can automate email campaigns; user experiences may vary.
intended_organization_or_user: Small nonprofits seeking to enhance their online fundraising efforts.
major_ideas: Fundraising requires a repeatable system, not random posts.
Understanding your ideal donor is crucial for effective communication.
Providing value through donor magnets can improve engagement.
Automated email series can turn leads into loyal donors.
prerequisites: Understanding of your nonprofit's mission and target audience.
Basic web design skills to implement donor magnets and sign-up forms.
proposed_workflow: Identify and define your ideal donor persona.
Develop a donor magnet that addresses the needs of your ideal donor.
Integrate a sign-up form for the donor magnet on your website and social channels.
Create a welcome email series to engage new subscribers.
Encourage existing supporters to share content to expand reach.
tools_templates_resources: Email marketing platforms (e.g., Mailchimp, Constant Contact).
Website builders with forms (e.g., WordPress, Wix).
